question.text: Ramesh is an RTA executive responsible for pre-AGM preparations. Which of the following is NOT part of the RTA's pre-AGM responsibilities?

answer.text: Setting up the e-voting event and uploading the shareholder database
Creating user ID and password credentials for e-voting
Providing the Attendance Register, votes polled in remote voting and at the AGM, and results thereof
Preparing Attendance Registers and Proxy Register

explanation.text: The Logic: The pre-AGM RTA responsibilities listed in the workbook include setting up the e-voting event, uploading the shareholder database, creating user ID and password credentials, and preparing the Attendance Register and Proxy Register. Providing the Attendance Register, votes polled in remote voting and at the AGM, and the results thereof is a post-AGM activity. The Trap: Each of options A, B and D is a pre-AGM task. Only option C — the post-AGM deliverable — sits outside the pre-AGM phase, which is why it is the correct NOT-pre-AGM choice. Note: The split between pre-AGM and post-AGM RTA activities, and the specific post-AGM deliverable of the Attendance Register, remote-voting and AGM-voting tallies and results, is set out on pages 161-162 of the NISM-Series-II-A Registrars and Transfer Agents (Corporate) Certification Examination workbook (October 2025).
